claims.title: Prime-zeta first-strip: exact Möbius residue criterion for local holomorphic removability
claims.declaration: Paper theorem: A⁺ locally removable at λ−1 iff M(λ)=0 (NOT Lean)
claims.claim: For every λ=ρ/n from a nontrivial ζ zero, A⁺ has local germ s M(λ) log(s−(λ−1))+holomorphic; complete local removability is equivalent to the finite Möbius residue M(λ)=0.
claims.scope: First strip −1<Re(s)<0, nonreal λ; local analytic branch of A⁺ from the original domain; no RH assumption; arithmetic requires complete certified active dilation fiber.
claims.mechanism: Normal convergence of the prime-zeta logarithmic derivative, exact residue identification, and the September first-layer identity A⁺=sP(s+1)+H.
claims.certificate: Self-contained written theorem in PRIME_ZETA_FIRST_STRIP_BOUNDARY_PAPER_THEOREMS_20261122.md; prior author-side PR #1035; independent reviewer/Lean proof absent; exact arithmetic CI 45053539129 is SYNTHETIC only. Direct classical proof source: https://mathworld.wolfram.com/PrimeZetaFunction.html (P' residues, coincident residue addition and removability).
claims.limit: Not an independently certified or first-priority result. Does not prove an actual multi-member zero fiber, global all-layer continuation, or RH. Dated specialist prior-art audit open. The P' residue-cancellation mechanism is already public classical prior art, not original NIGHTFALL mathematics.
claims.next: Issue #1040: independently reconstruct branch, residue and continuation proof; inspect Fröberg 1968 full text and obtain non-author review.

claims.title: Shifted prime-zeta deformation: natural boundary at Re(s)=−1
claims.declaration: Paper theorem: Re(s)=−1 is a natural boundary for A⁺ (NOT Lean)
claims.claim: The original shifted prime-difference series A⁺(s)=Σ_p[(p−1)^(−s)−p^(−s)] has no ordinary analytic continuation across any point of Re(s)=−1.
claims.scope: Ordinary holomorphic analytic continuation from Re(s)>0, including all locally continued branches; imports classical natural boundary Re(w)=0 for P(w).
claims.mechanism: A⁺=sP(s+1)+H; H crosses each nonreal boundary point because ζ(1+it)≠0 and the j≥3 remainder is holomorphic Re(s)>−2; any A⁺ extension would extend P.
claims.certificate: Source theorem in PRIME_ZETA_FIRST_STRIP_BOUNDARY_PAPER_THEOREMS_20261122.md; classical P natural boundary by Landau–Walfisz / Fröberg; PR #1035 paper proof; no named Lean analytic replay or independent referee.
claims.limit: The classical natural boundary is established prior art, not original. No global novelty clearance for this shifted corollary; formal k≥2 source coordinates behind the boundary are not ordinary reachable germs. The prime-zeta natural-boundary mechanism is directly classical; this is its shifted corollary, not a new boundary theorem mechanism.
